init_distributed_mode: init distributed training mode from environment variables or SLURM for multi-GPU PyTorch jobs
scaled_all_reduce: perform scaled all-reduce across distributed workers on a list of PyTorch tensors
all_gather_batch_with_grad: gather tensors from all distributed workers while preserving backward propagation for gradient computation
cosine_scheduler: generate a cosine annealing learning rate schedule with optional linear warmup for training iterations
GaussianBlur: apply random Gaussian blur augmentation to PIL images for self-supervised learning data transforms
